pattern: に～を重ねて（に～をかさねて）
purpose: Emphasize repeated accumulation of the same action.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Action noun + に + same noun + を重ねて
We chose the proposal after repeated careful consideration.
I learned the technique through failure after failure.
They kept the shop going through hardship after hardship.
formation: Action noun + に + same noun + を重ねて
restrictions: Often with 苦労, 検討, 失敗, and 練習.
mistake: Repeat the noun to show accumulation, rather than list different actions.
